summary: Iteration 162 — Milestone 1 Sustainability Module Configuration (backend + frontend). Created backend pytest suite (12 tests, ALL PASS) covering module/category/KPI/field-config/calculation CRUD, unique-constraint 409s, invalid-code 422s, tree endpoint, migrate idempotency, and org isolation via direct MongoDB check (ORG_A=8 modules, ORG_B=1 module, environment_records=101 unchanged). Ran full Playwright UI flow: login → /sustainability-config sidebar navigation → module create/delete via UI → drill-down Energy(7 cats) → Fuel Within Org KPI → Add Question dialog (field_type=2 opts, response_type=13 opts) save succeeds ('Questions saved' toast) and appears in table → Add Calculation dialog opens with full form → breadcrumb back-to-root works. Only one issue found: nested-button HTML causing React hydration warnings (module edit/delete icons are <button> nested inside module-card <button>).

ui_bugs.component: SustainabilityConfig / ModuleList (also affects CategoryList & KPIList if same pattern)
ui_bugs.issue: Nested <button> inside <button>: module-card is a <button data-testid='module-card-xxx'> that contains edit/delete icon <button> children (data-testid='edit-module-xxx' / 'delete-module-xxx'). Produces React DOM validation error and hydration warning on every render. Recommended fix: change outer module card to <div role='button' tabIndex={0}> with keyboard handler, or place edit/delete buttons outside the clickable card region. Same likely applies to category-card and kpi-card if they follow the same structure.

action_items: OPTIONAL (LOW): Refactor module/category/KPI card outer <button> to non-button element to eliminate nested-button hydration warnings.

OPTIONAL: Consider allowing DELETE on field configs (currently only new versions can be created — task spec says 'Delete it' for questions but the API only supports versioning, not per-field delete via a delete endpoint). Per-field removal is possible only by POSTing a new version without that field, which the UI does. This is by-design but worth confirming with product.
critical_code_review_comments: router.py — POST /categories under a missing module returns 409 (ValueError path) but semantically it should be 404. Consider distinguishing 'not-found parent' from 'duplicate-code' by raising a distinct exception in service.create_category.

service.py:502 ensure_indexes — org_module_kpis unique index does NOT include category_code+kpi_code ordering correctly for a common lookup pattern; also no explicit compound index on (organization_id, module_code, category_code, display_order) for KPI listing sort. Minor perf point at scale.
seed.py migration + service uniqueness: relies on Mongo unique indexes to catch races. ensure_indexes() must be called on backend startup — verify it's wired into the app lifespan/startup hook.
SustainabilityConfig.js line ~300 — outer module button contains nested edit/delete buttons: invalid HTML (see frontend_issues.ui_bugs).

delete_module cascade deletes categories/kpis/fields/calcs by (organization_id, module_code) — safe. But no soft-delete / audit trail entry for these destructive operations. Consider logging to audit_logs for compliance.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all core CRUD flows + navigation + dialogs work end-to-end; one non-blocking DOM validity warning)

rca of the issue: Nested-button React hydration warning RCA: <button data-testid='module-card-xxx'> is rendered with children <button data-testid='edit-module-xxx'> and <button data-testid='delete-module-xxx'>. HTML spec forbids interactive descendants inside <button>. Fix: change outer element to <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={enter->select}> so inner icon buttons are legal children.
